purpose: Transfer execution and retest/regime lessons from earlier EURUSD research without claiming they validate gold.

operations_only.entry: Frozen v1 H1 24-bar breakout with EMA200
operations_only.new_controls: Actual broker trade sessions; entries from 07:00 until 19:30 server time, Friday 16:30; close at 20:00, Friday 17:00; unchanged risk and stops.

regime_retest.entry: After a breakout, require a later closed H1 retest within 3 bars: low/high within 0.25 ATR of armed level, close beyond level by 0.02 ATR, EMA200 aligned, ADX14>=18 and nondecreasing.

selection_disclosure: Every window has already been viewed. Revisions are exploratory comparisons, not fresh out-of-sample validation. Retain both variants and all outcomes; no parameter grid search.
publishing: Publish research source and aggregate simulated backtests after privacy review; exclude broker account configurations and private credentials.
